id: title:VojtechBartos:raise pnpm fetch timeout for the local sandbox image

review.posthog_relevance: Developer experience and CI reliability for local sandbox builds
review.reason: Adds a 10-minute fetch timeout to pnpm commands in Dockerfile.sandbox-local. This is a localized maintenance change to the development environment, not production infrastructure. It could prevent CI failures during package installation in the sandbox, potentially saving developer time, but does not demonstrate broader systemic benefit or shared dependency changes.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on network conditions and CI configuration, which are not demonstrated in the code. No production or shared dependency impact is shown.
